About AI Guard Usage
Ask Zscaler

The AI Guard Usage dashboard provides an overview of the data usage by AI applications and users.

The AI Guard Usage page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

View general statistics about AI Guard usage by users and AI apps.
View usage based on specific time intervals.
About the AI Guard Usage Page

On the AI Guard Usage page (AI Guard > Usage), you can do the following:

Switch between the Users or AI Applications tab to view the corresponding data.
Select the date range for your data.
Refresh updates your dashboard with the most current data.
See AI application and user data on the following categories: Prompt Content Size, Response Content Size, Prompt Tokens, and Response Tokens.

The bar chart shows the total size of input and output content in bytes for AI applications or users.
